faq.heading: We answer your questions
faq.subheading: Everything you need to know to get started
faq.subheadingPro: Important information for mental health professionals
faq.subheadingPatient: We know taking the first step can be daunting. Here we answer the most common questions.

professional.question: What is PsyDoctor and who is it for?
professional.answer: PsyDoctor is a digital platform designed for mental health professionals who practice independently or in private settings. It streamlines operational management without interfering with clinical judgment or the therapeutic relationship.

professional.question: Does PsyDoctor replace my current practice or way of working?
professional.answer: No. PsyDoctor complements your practice. You decide how to provide care, whom to accept, and what information to share.

professional.question: How do patients find my profile?
professional.answer: Patients go through a guided orientation process based on symptoms and context. This ensures that people reaching your profile are seeking your specialty and approach, reducing early mismatches and dropouts.

professional.question: Can I decline or refer patients?
professional.answer: Yes. You retain full control over whom you treat. PsyDoctor does not obligate you to accept patients or constrain your clinical practice.

professional.question: What type of clinical information is shared?
professional.answer: Only basic, summarized information agreed upon by the professional and the patient (e.g., reason for consultation, relevant prior treatment). Complete clinical notes are never shared without consent.

professional.question: What happens if a patient changes professionals?
professional.answer: If the patient chooses to, they can share a summary of their process to avoid starting from scratch. This supports therapeutic continuity and the ethical care of the patient.

professional.question: How is patient confidentiality protected?
professional.answer: PsyDoctor upholds the highest privacy and confidentiality standards. All clinical information is managed with informed consent and is never used for commercial or advertising purposes.

patient.question: What is PsyDoctor and how can it help me?
patient.answer: PsyDoctor is a platform that connects you with verified psychologists and psychiatrists in Chile. Our goal is to ease your path to wellbeing by helping you find the right professional at your own pace, without pressure.

patient.question: How do I know the professionals are trustworthy?
patient.answer: All PsyDoctor professionals go through a verification process that includes validation of their university degree and professional registration. Only licensed practitioners authorized to practice in Chile work on our platform.

patient.question: Are my conversations private?
patient.answer: Absolutely. Your privacy is our top priority. All information you share is protected by professional confidentiality and data encryption. Neither PsyDoctor nor third parties have access to your conversations with your professional.

patient.question: How much does a session cost?
patient.answer: Each professional sets their own fees. You can see the price of each session before booking. Many professionals offer a first session at a reduced rate or free of charge so you can get to know them.

patient.question: What if I feel my professional isn't the right fit for me?
patient.answer: That's completely normal. The connection with your professional matters for your process. On PsyDoctor, you can change professionals whenever you need to — no commitments, no explanations needed. Your wellbeing comes first.

patient.question: Can I have online sessions?
patient.answer: Yes. Many professionals offer in-person sessions, online sessions, or both. You choose what's most comfortable for you. Online sessions are secure and work directly from the platform.

patient.question: Do I need a diagnosis to seek help?
patient.answer: No. You don't need a diagnosis or to know exactly what's wrong. You can seek support simply because you feel you need it, because you want to understand yourself better, or because you're going through a difficult time. The professional will help you explore whatever you need.
